descriptions.source_jitter_ms: Per-frame arrival delay above the network floor, from source PTS vs local arrival clock (sliding-window min baseline)
descriptions.arrival_to_decode_ms: Packet arrival on socket -> decoded frame available
descriptions.decode_to_record_ms: Decoded frame -> encoded & muxed into the 5-minute clip
descriptions.arrival_to_record_ms: Packet arrival -> frame persisted in clip (end-to-end ingestion, recording path)
descriptions.decode_to_frame_saved_ms: Decoded frame -> JPEG fully written to disk
descriptions.arrival_to_frame_saved_ms: Packet arrival -> JPEG on disk (end-to-end ingestion, extraction path)
descriptions.capture_to_frame_saved_ms: Estimated source capture time -> JPEG on disk (source-referenced end-to-end, excludes network floor)
descriptions.connect_rtt_ms: TCP handshake round-trip time to the RTSP server at each (re)connect

estimated_source_to_disk_ms.note: capture_to_frame_saved + RTT/2 network floor; excludes camera-internal encode delay
